61200.commentary: (THa) abbahe sallam'attano'ti attano hadayanissitaṃ rāg'ādisallaṃ uddhareyya samūhaneyyā'ti.

examples.text: pamādo rajo pamādo, pamād'ānupatito rajo, appamādena vijjāya, abbahe sallam'attano'ti.
uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, ko attho supitena vo, āturānañ'hi kā niddā, sallaviddhāna ruppataṃ.
tassa ce kāmayānassa, chandajātassa jantuno, te kāmā parihāyanti, sallaviddho'va ruppati.

61204.grammar: adj, masc gen pl of sallaviddha, comp, gen abs, irreg
61204.construction:
salla + viddha + ānaṃ > āna
sallaviddhānaṃ > sallaviddhāna

examples.text: santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.
lahukena asanenā'ti anto susiraṃ katvā tūl'ādīhi pūretvā katalakkhaparikammena sallahukakaṇḍena. evaṃ katañ'hi ekausabhagāmī dve usabhāni'pi gacchati… aṭṭh'usabhagāmī soḷasa usabhāni'pi gacchati.
santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.

61209.commentary: (DNa) kathāsallāpo'ti kathā ca sallāpo ca, kathanaṃ paṭikathanan'ti attho.

examples.text: app'eva nāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena samāgaccheyyāma? app'eva nāma siyā koci'd'eva kathāsallāpo'ti!
assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa māgaṇḍiyena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aparena samayena susallikhitagatto pāṇinā gattāni anumajjanto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi

61215.commentary: (DNa) sīhā'va sallīnā'ti sīhā viya nilīnā ekattaṃ upagatā.

examples.text: puthūsīhā'va sallīnā, lomahaṃs'ābhisambhuno, odātamanasā suddhā, vippasanna'm'anāvilā.

61220.meaning1: effacing; expunging; erasing; wiping out; slowly grinding away
61220.commentary: (MNa) sallekho'ti ca idha avihiṃsā'va veditabbā. avihiṃsā hi vihiṃsaṃ sallekhati, taṃ chindati, tasmā sallekho'ti vuccati. esa nayo sabbattha. ayaṃ pana viseso.

examples.text: tañ'hi tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ app'icchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya subharatāya vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattissati
tassa evam'assa, sallekhena viharāmī'ti. na kho pan'ete, cunda, ariyassa vinaye sallekhā vuccanti. diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārā ete ariyassa vinaye vuccanti.
apaññattena vuccamāno, idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhut'atthāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattatī'ti anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
nivatth'avatthen'eva gehato nikkhamitvā paramasallekhavuttiko'pi abalabalo amandamando viya paresaṃ acittakarūpena hīḷitaparibhūto hutvā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu ekarattivāsen'eva vicarati.
acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, tathāgatassa app'icchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā. yatra hi nāma tathāgato evaṃ mah'iddhiko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo.

61223.meaning1: way of effacing; method of erasing
61223.commentary: (MNa) sallekhapariyāyo'ti sallekhakāraṇaṃ. esa nayo sabbattha ettha avihiṃs'ādayo eva vihiṃs'ādīnaṃ sallekhanato sallekhakāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: iti kho, cunda, desito mayā sallekhapariyāyo, desito citt'uppādapariyāyo, desito parikkamanapariyāyo, desito uparibhāgapariyāyo, desito parinibbānapariyāyo. yaṃ kho, cunda, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

61225.meaning1: with ascetic lifestyle; with an austere mode of being
61225.commentary: (VINa) yā ca kilese sallikhati, sā etesaṃ vuttī'ti sallekhavuttino.

61226.commentary: (ANt) aho sallekhitan'ti aho ativiya sallekhena itaṃ pavattaṃ.

examples.text: tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bādhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.

61228.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sasakka
61228.meaning1: as much as possible; as much as one can; (comm) definitely; certainly
61228.commentary: (MNa) sasakkaṃ na karaṇīyan'ti ek'aṃsen'eva na kātabbaṃ. (MNa) sasakkan'ti ek'aṃs'atthe nipāto, viññū puriso ek'aṃsen'eva na vaseyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: akusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti, evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyena kammaṃ sasakkaṃ na karaṇīyaṃ.
tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā rahovādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sasakkaṃ, taṃ rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya.

61231.meaning1: holding in place with intention; intentionally managing
61231.commentary: (DNa) appaguṇasāsavasamādhi viya sasaṅkhārena sappayogena cittena paccanīkadhamme niggayha kilese vāretvā anadhigatattā nasasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato. tañ'ca samādhiṃ samāpajjanto tato vā vuṭṭhahanto sativepullapattattā.
61231.sanskrit: sa + saḥ + sva + śvan + saṃskāra + nigrahāya

examples.text: ayaṃ samādhi akāpurisasevito'ti paccattaṃ'y'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhaladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato, na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayha vāritavato'ti paccattaṃ'y'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.

61232.meaning1: held in place and restrained by intention; intentionally managed and controlled
61232.commentary: (ANa) sasaṅkhārena sappayogena kilese niggaṇhitvā vāretvā ṭhito, kilesānaṃ pana chinnante uppanno'ti na sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato.

examples.text: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāv'ādhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.

61234.commentary: (ANa) yattha katthaci uppanno pana sasaṅkhārena sappayogena arahattaṃ patto sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī nāma.

examples.text: no ce pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, atha pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.

61236.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of sasaṅkhāra
61236.construction:
sa + saṃ + √kar > khār + *a + ena
sasaṅkhāra + ena

61237.meaning1: with the community; with the assembly

examples.text: dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.

61238.construction:
sa + saṃ + √ñā + ā + a
sasaññā + a

examples.text: sasaññā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no asaññā. tassā'y'eva saññāya pahānā evaṃ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī'ti.

61239.construction:
sa + saṃ + √ñā + ā + ī
sasaññā + ī

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

61243.meaningLit: in the sphere of the sword
61243.commentary: (ADHt) sasatth'āvacaro padeso viya satte sasanti hiṃsanti tehī'ti satthā, saha satthehī'ti sasatthā, sasatthā purisā avacaranti etthā'ti sasatth'āvacaro.

examples.text: so kho pana me, bhante, vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho sadaṇḍ'āvacaro sasatth'āvacaro na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.

kiṃ saṃyojanā nu kho, mārisa, devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye c'aññe santi puthukāyā, te, averā adaṇḍā asapattā abyāpajjā viharemu averinoti iti ca nesaṃ hoti, atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā sabyāpajjā viharanti saverino'ti?

61246.commentary: (JAa) sasabiḷāre'ti sase c'eva biḷāre ca. etena thalacare mige dasseti.

examples.text: gavassa ce'pi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaññ'eva pahāraṃ deti, no asakkaccaṃ, dīpissa ce'pi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaññ'eva pahāraṃ deti, no asakkaccaṃ, khuddakānañ'ce'pi pāṇānaṃ pahāraṃ deti antamaso sasabiḷārānam'pi, sakkaccaññ'eva pahāraṃ deti, no asakkaccaṃ.
araññe kuṭikaṃ katvā, kūṭāni kārayanti te, sasabiḷāre bādhenti, āgodhā macchakacchapaṃ.
paccattaṃ sasarīresu, manussesv'etaṃ na vijjati, vokārañ'ca manussesu, samaññāya pavuccati.

61253.commentary: (PMa) sasallo'ti pīḷājanakatāya antotudanatāya dunnīharaṇīyatāya ca sallā'ti saṅkhaṃ gatehi rāg'ādīhi sallehi sahavattanako.

examples.text: yesam'pi sallaṃ urasi paviṭṭhaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ hadayaṃ vedhamānaṃ, te'p'īdha soppaṃ labhare sasallā, tasmā ahaṃ na supe vītasallo.
uddhato loko avūpasanto'ti, passantānaṃ … sasallo lokasannivāso, viddho puthusallehi, tassa n'atth'añño koci sallānaṃ uddhatā, aññatra mayā'ti, passantānaṃ …

examples.text: yadā sasavisāṇānaṃ, nisseṇī sukatā siyā, saggass'ārohaṇ'atthāya, atha nūna tadā siyā.

61255.commentary: (SNa) sabbe sasaṃyojanā'ti sabbe sabandhanā, keci sot'āpannā, keci sakadāgāmino, keci anāgāmino. tesu hi puthujjano vā khīṇ'āsavo vā n'atthi.

examples.text: atha kho tiṃsamattā pāveyyakā bhikkhū sabbe āraññikā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sabbe sasaṃyojanā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

61256.meaning2: ending with the ocean; as far as the sea

yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, puriso gūthakūpe sasīsako nimuggo assa. atha tvaṃ purise āṇāpeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ tamhā gūthakūpā uddharathā'ti.

61265.meaning1: head high; over one's head; head and all
61265.construction:
sa + sīsa + ka + aṃ
sasīsaka + aṃ

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, puriso gūthakūpe sasīsakaṃ nimuggo assa. atha tvaṃ purise āṇāpeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ tamhā gūthakūpā uddharathā'ti.

61266.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sasīsa
61266.meaning1: up to the head; including the head
61266.meaning2: together with the head, up to the head
61266.commentary: (SNa) sasīsaṃ pārutaṃ nisinnan'ti saha sīsena pārutakāyaṃ nisinnaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupetvā nisinno assa
addasā kho sā bhikkhunī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvā sasīsaṃ pārupitvā mañcake nipajji.
yo mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā, bhātaraṃ bhaginiṃ sasuṃ, hanti roseti vācāya, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, suṇisā sasuraṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati
sā aparena samayena saṃvāsam'anvāya vissāsam'anvāya sassum'pi sasuram'pi sāmikam'pi evam'āha, apetha, kiṃ pana tumhe jānāthā'ti!

61269.meaning2: father in law's side of the family

examples.text: sūcigharaṃ nāma sasūcikaṃ vā asūcikaṃ vā.

61271.meaning1: with an army; commanding an army

examples.text: kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

61272.meaning1: accompanied by sadness; sorrowful; full of grief

examples.text: yattha atthi āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ. yattha atthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ, sasokaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, sadaraṃ saupāyāsan'ti vadāmi.
seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattessāmi, tejo pātukarissāmī'ti.

61275.commentary: (ANa) visamapākāni sassāni bhavantī'ti ekasmiṃ ṭhāne gabbhīni honti, ekasmiṃ sañjātakhīrāni, ekaṃ ṭhānaṃ paccatī'ti evaṃ visamaṃ pākāni sassāni bhavan'ti.

examples.text: deve na sammā dhāraṃ anuppavecchante visamapākāni sassāni bhavanti. visamapākāni, bhikkhave, sassāni manussā paribhuñjantā app'āyukā honti dubbaṇṇā ca bavh'ābādhā ca.

āgantukassa dānaṃ deti, gamikassa dānaṃ deti, gilānassa dānaṃ deti, dubbhikkhe dānaṃ deti, yāni tāni navasassāni navaphalāni tāni paṭhamaṃ sīlavantesu patiṭṭhāpeti. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāladānānī'ti.

61278.commentary: (SNa) sassaghātaṃ maññe carasī'ti sassaṃ ghātento viya āhiṇḍasi.

examples.text: atha kiñ'carahi tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi? sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi, kul'ūpaghātaṃ maññe carasi. olujjati kho te, āvuso ānanda, parisā, palujjanti kho te, āvuso, navappāyā.

61279.meaning1: eternal; everlasting; endless; perpetual; (comm) existing forever

examples.text: ākāse'va padaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo n'atthi bāhire, saṅkhārā sassatā n'atthi, n'atthi buddhānam'iñjitaṃ.
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca. ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.

61280.meaning1: eternalism; doctrine of an everlasting soul
61280.commentary: (PMa) sassatan'ti pavattā diṭṭhi sassatadiṭṭhi. ucchedo'ti pavattā diṭṭhi ucchedadiṭṭhi. (ADHa) sassato attā ca loko cā'ti pavattā diṭṭhi sassatadiṭṭhi. ucchijjissatī'ti pavattā diṭṭhi ucchedadiṭṭhi.

examples.text: na h'eva kho rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, na saññaṃ… na saṅkhāre… na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, api ca kho evaṃdiṭṭhi hoti, so attā so loko, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo'ti. yā kho pana sā, bhikkhave, sassatadiṭṭhi saṅkhāro so.

61281.meaning2: connected with the view of an eternal soul

61282.meaningLit: discourse on the view of eternalism

61283.meaning1: eternalism; doctrine of an everlasting soul
61283.commentary: (VISMa) sassato attā ca loko cā'tiādinayappavatto (dī. ni. 1.31) sassatavādo.

examples.text: te ca sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti, atthi'tv'eva sassatisaman'ti. ayaṃ paṭhamo sassatavādo.

61284.meaning1: teaching about the doctrine of eternalism

61285.meaning1: eternalist; proponent of the doctrine of an everlasting soul
61285.commentary: (NPa) ime vuccanti sassatavādino'ti ime rūpavantaṃ vā attānan'ti-ādinā rūp'ādivinimutto añño koci attā'ti upagacchantā so nicco dhuvo sassato'ti abhinivisanato sassatavādino'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhātī'ti kāraṇ'ākāraṇe na saṇṭhāti. tatr'āyaṃ nayo, sassatavādī yuttena kāraṇena pahoti ucchedavādiṃ niggahetuṃ, ucchedavādī tena niggayhamāno, kiṃ pan'āhaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmī'ti
[yathā sassatavāre, tathā vitthāretabbaṃ]

61288.commentary: (DNa) sassatī'ti niccaṃ vijjamānatāya mahāpathaviṃva maññati, tathā sinerupabbatacandimasūriye. tato tehi samaṃ attānaṃ maññamānā atthi tv'eva sassatisaman'ti vadanti.

examples.text: atthi nu kho bhante kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati
atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

61289.commentary: (DNa) ekaccasassatikā'ti ekaccasassatavādā. te duvidhā honti, satt'ekaccasassatikā, saṅkhār'ekaccasassatikā'ti. duvidhā'pi idha gahitā'y'eva.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekaccasassatikā ekacca-asassatikā ekaccaṃ sassataṃ ekaccaṃ asassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi.

61290.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sassatisama

examples.text: atha vā pan'assa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti, yo me ayaṃ attā vado vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti so kho pana me ayaṃ attā nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassatī'ti
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca. ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.
so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.

na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā, mudukā tūlinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā. atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā ādāya.

61295.meaning1: with a benefactor; with a patron
61295.commentary: (VIN 1.2.7) sassāmikan'ti añño koci sāmiko hoti itthī vā puriso vā gahaṭṭho vā pabbajito vā.

examples.text: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
mahallako nāma vihāro sassāmiko vuccati.

61296.meaning1: with a husband; (comm) with a protector
61296.commentary: (MNa) sabhāgakulāni pana kucchigatesu'pi gabbhesu katikaṃ karonti, sace mayhaṃ putto hoti, tuyhaṃ dhītā, aññattha gantuṃ na labhissati, mayhaṃ puttass'eva hotū'ti. evaṃ gabbhe'pi pariggahitā sassāmikā nāma.

examples.text: kāmesumicchācārī kho pana hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sassāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti.

61298.meaning1: with an owner; belonging to someone

examples.text: tassa kammavipākajaṃ dibbacakkhu pāturahosi yena nidhiṃ passati sassāmikam'pi assāmikam'pi. so rājānaṃ mahāsudassanaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āha, app'ossukko tvaṃ, deva, hohi, ahaṃ te dhanena dhanakaraṇīyaṃ karissāmī'ti.

ativiya sobhaggappatto brāhmaṇassa attabhāvo. arājake ṭhāne rājānaṃ kātuṃ yuttam'imaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ, evam'esa sassiriko, iti naṃ pokkharasadisattā pokkharasātī'ti sañjānanti, pokkhare pana so nibbatto, na mātukucchiyanti iti naṃ pokkhare sayitattā pokkharasāyī'ti'pi sañjānanti.
